verdict.rationale: Dagster lets you declare asset dependencies in code (`@dg.asset(deps=[hello])`). Its Declarative Automation uses the status of assets and their dependencies to launch executions, for example `on_cron` running an asset only after all upstream dependencies have updated. External tools like Airbyte can also be chained with upstream and downstream steps, and community users praise the asset-centric approach. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of in-run execution-ordering semantics, and independent hands-on corroboration of dependency-ordered runs.
